hints.text: Track two states: optimal alternating subsequence ending with an addition, and ending with a subtraction.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Advance through numbers updating the add state from preceding subtract state plus current value.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Update the subtract state from preceding add state minus current value.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
def maxAlternatingSum(nums: list[int]) -> int:
    even = 0  # after adding
    odd = 0   # after subtracting
    for x in nums:
        even = max(even, odd + x)
        odd = max(odd, even - x)
    return even
```
